description: This file defines the SerializerConfigurationAnalyzer class which analyzes serializer configurations in the Orleans.Serialization namespace, focusing on identifying potential issues with serializability of types used in grain interface methods.

classes.name: SerializerConfigurationAnalyzer
classes.description: A static class that provides methods to analyze serializer configurations and identify serialization issues in Orleans.

classes.name: SerializerConfigurationComplaint
classes.description: A class representing a potential configuration issue related to the serializability of a particular type, including references to interface methods that involve this type.

methods.name: AnalyzeSerializerAvailability
methods.description: Analyzes grain interface methods to find parameter types and return types which are not serializable, given a codec provider and interface options.
